interpretation: Fixed full-data variogram, whole-borehole/group five-fold CV; conditional validation, not nested variogram selection.
binary_scope: Raw SISIM sand probability at withheld observed Neogene samples (observed classes 1 or 2), not final hierarchical sand probability.
plot_bins: Fixed 50 bins of width .02, intervals (lower,upper], p=0 included in first bin. Empty bins remain NaN. No smoothing.
reference: Wiegel, Peña-Olarte & Cudmani 2024, doi:10.1002/gete.202400011, Figs. 7a and 9. Our CV remains five-fold for both.
